title: Production Language Server
acceptance_criteria: Diagnostics, navigation, completion, references, rename, and fixes operate correctly on unsaved buffers.
Multiple workspace roots cannot leak declarations or edits across project boundaries.
Editor clients consume one compiler-owned semantic interpretation with no client-local fallback semantics.
Large-workspace latency, cancellation, memory, and restart behavior meet published baselines.
